content.short: Learn English from a feed of short real videos with tap-to-translate words and weekly WLD prizes.
content.description: Falora teaches English, aimed first at Spanish speakers, through an endless feed of short clips of everyday speech. Words translate as they are spoken, grammar notes pop up for phrases like 'keep dreaming', and six exercise types cover levels A1 to C2. Learning is free, and an optional weekly challenge pays WLD and USDT prize pots. It runs inside World App.
content.meta: Learn real-world English from short videos with tap-to-translate and optional WLD prize challenges in Falora, on World App.
